items.why: Volatility is spiking as the sharp tech sell-off fractures the market into two camps, deepening hedge fund losses this week, per Reuters and MarketWatch.
Oil is climbing while futures fall, one of the two world-changing factors the market is reeling from, as investors weigh earnings, per Yahoo Finance and Barron's.
No single headline; steadying with the Nasdaq as tech stocks settle after the sharp sell-off, per Reuters.
The Dow is down after a sharp tech sell-off, with the market split into two camps and investors suffering a brutal case of whiplash, per MarketWatch.

market_note: Live afternoon trade: tech sell-off eases on the Nasdaq, oil leads higher, Taiwan market shut for Typhoon Champi.
summary: It is a split tape Friday: the Dow is down over 1% on the tech sell-off while the Nasdaq steadies, oil climbs, and the VIX jumps nearly 6%.
